description: This file defines the SpriteTextActivity class, which is an Android activity managing an OpenGL ES rendering surface for sprite text rendering. It initializes a GLSurfaceView, sets up a custom GLWrapper, and a renderer, handling lifecycle events to pause and resume rendering.

classes.name: SpriteTextActivity
classes.description: Android activity that manages the lifecycle of a GLSurfaceView with a custom renderer and GLWrapper for sprite text rendering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GLSurfaceView, sets a custom GLWrapper that wraps the GL object into a MatrixTrackingGL, assigns a SpriteTextRenderer, and sets it as the activity's content view.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the GLSurfaceView rendering when the activity is paused.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes the GLSurfaceView rendering when the activity is resumed.
